author: 9to5Google
description:
I spent two weeks testing Google’s budget ecosystem, the Pixel 10a, Fitbit Air, and Pixel Buds 2a, to see if the cheapest way into Pixel, Fitbit, and Gemini is worth buying this holiday season. With Black Friday and holiday sales bringing the full setup down to around $550, here’s my honest review of the battery life, cameras, Google Health tracking, sound quality, and which device to skip.

Pricing: 
Pixel 10a: Could be found as low as $350 this holiday season 
Pixel Buds 2a: $99 lowest price seen 
Fitbit Air: $99 with no sales YET 👀

Total: $550 if you get the right sales at the right time 😎
